name: Sakura Cloud
line: Create and manage virtual servers on Sakura's cloud infrastructure.

free.text: No ongoing free production server plan

cells.regions: Ishikari (3 zones), Tokyo (2); disks must match zone
cells.selfhost: Yes; customer manages the VM and apps

work.math: ¥1,540 for the VM + ¥440 for SSD = ¥1,980 a month with tax. 100 GB of data sent out is below the 1.6 TB guideline. Builds run on the VM or outside CI.
¥1,540 for the VM + ¥440 for SSD = ¥1,980 a month with tax, for 730 hours. 100 GB is below the 1.6 TB guideline, but throughput is not verified.

¥2,145 for the VM + ¥440 for SSD + 30 runs at ¥3 + 7 archives at ¥220 = ¥4,215 a month with tax. Assumes 30 runs and seven full 20 GB archives kept all month. Whether the database fits is not verified.
